terra.problem: The text does not say there was no crowd or give the reason the LORD chose this place.
The text does not say there was no pause or that the potter moved immediately to the next shape.
The passage does not mention the good being passed to another nation, but it does not say that nothing gets handed to anyone else.
The passage says the people burned incense to idols; it does not say they praised them.
The passage calls the bypaths rutted but does not say they are rough the whole way.
The passage says they walk on bypaths instead of the highway, not that the bypaths run beside it.
The passage does not say passersby stop and stare or that they do not live there.
The passage reports what the people say, but does not say Jeremiah hears them or that they are sure they will be fine without his message.
Taking someone's words to another person does not necessarily mean listening to them.
The passage reports what the people say, but does not say Jeremiah hears them.
